selection: Highest target validation full-vocabulary answer accuracy among the three declared updates; tie by lower validation cross entropy then earlier update. Same 64 validation labels and search budget for every condition. Also evaluate the fixed final update as sensitivity. No test feedback or hyperparameter search.
geometry: 1 minus biased linear CKA of target final_norm at task-free ONE_END on x and frozen teacher ONE_END on inverse(x), centered within a single length minibatch. No coordinate adapter, no source gradients. Weight fixed before outcomes.
mismatch: One fixed cyclic derangement within (length, true target training answer), using only the 192 training labels. Singleton groups excluded from geometry in both correct and mismatch conditions; every eligible example changes partner. Same eligibility for distillation+alignment. Output distillation always uses the correctly transformed teacher output.
label_budget: 256 target labels per replicate: 192 used in gradient losses, 64 used in checkpoint selection. No extra unlabeled training pool. Oracle source-audit/test labels are measurement only. Source pretraining already contains substantial source supervision and is shared by all teacher-assisted conditions.
primary_metric: New-test target full-vocabulary first-answer-token accuracy of validation-selected target model; target sees x alone at test, no teacher forwarding or transformation in its prediction.
uncertainty: Report all six paired replicates. Paired bootstrap over six target/support replicates is conditional on three frozen teachers; separately average the two replicates within each teacher and bootstrap three teacher clusters. Three teachers share a historical data world. No claim of six independent source retrainings.
scope: One prospective functional assay using supplied inverse correspondence and frozen pretrained teachers. Tests whether imposed geometry improves few-label target learning under these fixed settings, not spontaneous discovery of inverse algebra. A null result does not rule out other geometry weights, budgets or algorithms. Do not expand to a second pair before completing and reporting this pair.
